exams.notes: Board may accept NBME, NBEOOPS, or NJCPTP examinations; USMLE and COMLEX referenced in Interstate Medical Licensure Compact eligibility criteria
exams.quote: Has successfully completed an examination prescribed by the board

interval_years.quote: the annual license renewal fee is due on July 1 of each year. Every registered podiatrist shall renew his license on or before July 1 of each year

required.quote: the board may require licensees to submit to interrogation as to the nature and extent of their postgraduate medical education and to require licensees found to be deficient in their efforts to keep abreast of new methods and technology, to obtain additional instruction and training therein

value: recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma (1 hour, one-time)
topical_requirements.quote: demonstrate completion of a one (1) time course of at least one (1) hour of continuing medical education approved by the board and covering the recognition and prevention of pediatric abusive head trauma

available.quote: Issue regular licenses without further testing by endorsement from another state having qualifications and standards at least as high as those of this state or by endorsement from the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons, the National Joint Committee of Preregistration Physician Training Programs, or any approved successors thereof

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement from another state with equivalent qualifications; applicant must have been endorsed in writing as licensed in good standing and must have satisfied all requirements for regular licensure
requirements.quote: An applicant seeking regular licensure in the Commonwealth who was originally licensed in another state may obtain licensure in the Commonwealth without further testing and training if the applicant has been endorsed in writing by the applicant's original licensing state as being licensed in good standing in that state; and would have satisfied all the requirements for regular licensure

exists.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Medical Licensure

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners; National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
national_certification.quote: Issue regular licenses without further testing by endorsement from another state having qualifications and standards at least as high as those of this state or by endorsement from the National Board of Medical Examiners, the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons

national_association.value: American Medical Association; American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: any departure from, or failure to conform to the principles of medical ethics of the American Medical Association or the code of ethics of the American Osteopathic Association

credential_type.quote: "Regular license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy at any place in this state

is_mandatory.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state...unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

title_protection.quote: No person shall, in connection with the practice of medicine, surgery, osteopathy...hold himself or herself out as a doctor or employ or use in any manner the title "Doctor" or "Dr.," unless he or she actually has graduated and holds a doctor degree

scope_protection.quote: no person shall engage or attempt to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy within this state...unless the person holds a valid and effective license or permit issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or presenting false, fraudulent, or forged statements in connection with a license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made or presented, or caused to be made or presented, any false, fraudulent, or forged statement, writing, certificate, diploma, or other thing, in connection with an application for a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or aiding in fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with a licensure examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practiced, or aided or abetted in the practice of fraud, forgery, deception, collusion, or conspiracy in connection with an examination for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing, procuring, or aiding in procurement of an unlawful abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed, procured, or aided in the procurement of an unlawful abortion, including a partial-birth abortion or an abortion in violation of KRS 311.731

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty or nolo contendere plea or conviction of a crime in accordance with KRS Chapter 335B
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered a guilty or nolo contendere plea, or been convicted, by any court within or without the Commonwealth of Kentucky of a crime as defined in KRS 335B.010, if in accordance with KRS Chapter 335B

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of sexual offense involving a patient or finding of sexual contact with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a misdemeanor offense under KRS Chapter 510 involving a patient, or a felony offense under KRS Chapter 510, 530.064(1)(a), or 531.310, or been found by the board to have had sexual contact as defined in KRS 510.010(7) with a patient while the patient was under the care of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming addicted to a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become addicted to a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming a chronic or persistent alcoholic
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become a chronic or persistent alcoholic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice medicine according to acceptable standards by reason of mental or physical illness or other condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been unable or is unable to practice medicine according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental or physical illness or other condition including but not limited to physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills, or by reason of an extended absence from the active practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or any member thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement in any document in connection with the practice of the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made, or caused to be made, or aided or abetted in the making of, a false statement in any document executed in connection with the practice of his profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or aiding in the unlawful practice of medicine or osteopathy by an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed, as a practitioner of medicine or osteopathy in the practice of his profession in this state, any person not duly licensed or otherwise aided, assisted, or abetted the unlawful practice of medicine or osteopathy or any other healing art

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of any medical practice act or valid board regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of, or conspired to violate any provision or term of any medical practice act, including but not limited to the code of conduct promulgated by the board under KRS 311.601 or any other valid regulation of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any agreed order, letter of agreement, final order, or emergency order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or attempting to practice medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in or attempted to engage in the practice of medicine or osteopathy under a false or assumed name, or impersonated another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtained a fee or other thing of value on the fraudulent representation that a manifestly incurable condition could be cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violating a confidential communication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully violated a confidential communication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his license to practice medicine or osteopathy in any other state, territory, or foreign nation revoked, suspended, restricted, or limited or has been subjected to other disciplinary action by the licensing authority thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, rebates, or compensation for referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Given or received, directly or indirectly, from any person, firm, or corporation, any fee, commission, rebate, or other form of compensation for sending, referring, or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a person licensed under KRS 311.530 to 311.620 in his professional capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removal, suspension, or discipline by a professional medical association for unprofessional conduct, incompetence, or malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been removed, suspended, expelled, or disciplined by any professional medical association or society when the action was based upon what the association or society found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provision of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by a hospital or medical staff for unprofessional conduct, incompetence, malpractice, or violation of KRS Chapter 311
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of the hospital, including removal, suspension, limitation of hospital privileges, failing to renew privileges for cause, resignation of privileges under pressure or investigation, or other disciplinary action if the action was based upon what the hospital or medical staff found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provisions of KRS Chapter 311

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with medical records or reporting requirements under specified statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with the requirements of KRS 213.101, 311.782, or 311.783 or failed to submit to the Vital Statistics Branch in accordance with a court order a complete report as described in KRS 213.101

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of female genital mutilation, resulting in mandatory license revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of female genital mutilation under KRS 508.125, which shall result in mandatory revocation of a license

definition_quote.value: the 'practice of medicine or osteopathy' means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities
definition_quote.quote: the "practice of medicine or osteopathy" means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

value: all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities
methods_authorized.quote: the "practice of medicine or osteopathy" means the diagnosis, treatment, or correction of any and all human conditions, ailments, diseases, injuries, or infirmities by any and all means, methods, devices, or instrumentalities

license_status_types.quote: "Regular license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy at any place in this state; "Limited license" means a license to practice medicine or osteopathy in a specific institution or locale to the extent indicated in the license; "Temporary permit" means a permit issued to a person who has applied for a regular license; "Emergency permit" means a permit issued to a physician currently licensed in another state, authorizing the physician to practice in this state for the duration of a specific medical emergency, not to exceed thirty (30) days

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must pass the board-prescribed examination, be certified by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or an approved US specialty board, complete board-approved postgraduate training, and fulfill all other reasonable qualifications prescribed by the board by regulation.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Has been certified by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates or by an approved United States specialty board

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician providing telehealth must ensure informed consent and maintain confidentiality; prescribing via electronic communication requires verification of patient identity, establishment of a documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintenance of a current medical record; electronic/online/telephonic evaluation by questionnaire is inadequate for initial or follow-up evaluation.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: In response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship: Verification that the person requesting medication is in fact who the patient claims to be; Establishment of a documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and Maintenance of a current medical record

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the Compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision" means overseeing the activities of and accepting of responsibility for the medical services rendered by a physician assistant

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe and administer all nonscheduled legend drugs and medical devices to the extent delegated by the supervising physician; with board approval and at least one year of experience, may prescribe Schedule III, IV, and V controlled substances as delegated by supervising physician, subject to quantity limits (Schedule III: 30-day supply, no refills; Schedule IV/V: up to 6-month supply; benzodiazepines and Carisoprodol: 30-day supply, no refills).
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant who has been approved by the board pursuant to paragraph (b) of this subsection, may prescribe and administer Schedules III, IV, and V controlled substances, as described in KRS Chapter 218A, to the extent delegated by the supervising physician

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician may enter into supervision agreements with no more than four (4) physician assistants and shall not supervise more than four (4) physician assistants at any one (1) time.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Been disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of the hospital, including removal, suspension, limitation of hospital privileges, failing to renew privileges for cause, resignation of privileges under pressure or investigation, or other disciplinary action if the action was based upon what the hospital or medical staff found to be unprofessional conduct, professional incompetence, malpractice, or a violation of any provisions of KRS Chapter 311. This subsection shall not require relitigation of the disciplinary action

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish by contract, including with a nonprofit corporation, or otherwise the Kentucky Physician Health Foundation to promote the early identification, intervention, treatment, and rehabilitation of individuals licensed by the board who may be impaired by reason of illness, alcohol or drug abuse, or as a result of any physical or mental condition.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: When a hearing or inquiry panel has probable cause to believe a physician is suffering from a physical or mental condition that might impede his ability to practice competently, the panel may order the physician to undergo a physical or mental examination by persons designated by the panel.

sexual_misconduct_training_required.quote: The board, the hearing officer, and investigators hired by the board shall receive training on the dynamics of sexual misconduct of professionals, including the nature of this abuse of authority, characteristics of the offender, the impact on the victim, the possibility and the impact of false accusations, investigative procedure in sex offense cases, and effective intervention with victims and offenders.
